nodes.description: Boolean flag controlling whether the public sale is active.
Maximum number of NFTs that can ever be minted.
Randomized starting index used to shuffle token metadata.
Block number recorded when the starting index seed should be captured.
Base URI prefix used by _baseURI for token metadata.
Owner address maintained by the Ownable base contract.
Constant mint price of 0.01 ETH per NFT.
Owner-only function that toggles saleIsActive.
Owner-only function transferring the contract balance to the caller.
Owner-only function that mints a batch of reserved tokens to the caller.
Owner-only setter that updates MAX_SUPPLY.
Public payable function minting a single NFT to the caller.
Public payable function minting five NFTs to the caller.
Owner-only function computing startingIndex from a past block hash.
Owner-only function that sets startingIndexBlock to the current block.number.
Owner-only function that updates the base URI.
View function returning the metadata URI for a tokenId.
Internal view function returning the stored base URI.
Untrusted caller-controlled address used as mint recipient and withdrawal recipient.
External value transfer of the entire contract balance to msg.sender.
External callback into the receiver contract performed by _safeMint.
Use of blockhash/block.number as a pseudo-randomness source for startingIndex.
Arithmetic via SafeMath add and mul in mint5 supply and price checks.
Parameter num: number of reserve tokens to mint.
Parameter maxSupply: new value for MAX_SUPPLY.
Parameter baseURI_: new base URI string.
Parameter tokenId: token whose URI is queried.
Local supply holding current totalSupply in reserveTokens.
Loop counter i in reserveTokens.
Local balance holding the contract ETH balance in withdraw.
Local _tokenURI read from _tokenURIs mapping in tokenURI.
Local base holding the result of _baseURI() in tokenURI.

edges.reason: flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive flag.
withdraw reads address(this).balance into the local balance variable.
msg.sender is the recipient of the full balance transfer in withdraw.
withdraw performs an external value transfer to the caller.
withdraw is guarded by onlyOwner using _owner.
reserveTokens reads totalSupply into the local supply variable.
reserveTokens uses loop counter i to mint sequentially.
reserveTokens mints tokens to the caller msg.sender.
reserveTokens calls _safeMint which invokes the receiver callback.
reserveTokens is guarded by onlyOwner using _owner.
setMaxTokenSupply writes the new value into MAX_SUPPLY.
setMaxTokenSupply is guarded by onlyOwner using _owner.
mint checks saleIsActive before minting.
mint checks totalSupply against MAX_SUPPLY.
mint calls _safeMint with msg.sender as recipient.
mint calls _safeMint which invokes the receiver callback.
mint5 checks saleIsActive before minting.
mint5 checks totalSupply.add(5) against MAX_SUPPLY.
mint5 calls _safeMint with msg.sender as recipient.
mint5 performs SafeMath add and mul arithmetic on supply and price.
mint5 loops _safeMint five times, each invoking the receiver callback.
calcStartingIndex writes the computed value into startingIndex.
calcStartingIndex consumes startingIndexBlock derived from block.number.
calcStartingIndex derives randomness from blockhash and block.number.
calcStartingIndex is guarded by onlyOwner using _owner.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes block.number into startingIndexBlock.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is guarded by onlyOwner using _owner.
setBaseURI writes baseURI_ into _baseURIExtended.
setBaseURI is guarded by onlyOwner using _owner.
_baseURI returns the stored _baseURIExtended value.
tokenURI reads the per-token URI from _tokenURIs[tokenId].
tokenURI stores the base URI result in the local base variable.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to obtain the base string.
The receiver callback is invoked with the untrusted caller context during safe minting.

normalization_plan.reason: The num parameter only controls the reserveTokens minting loop and has no independent semantics.
The maxSupply parameter is only used to write MAX_SUPPLY inside setMaxTokenSupply.
The baseURI_ parameter is only used to store _baseURIExtended inside setBaseURI.
The tokenId parameter is only used to index token data inside tokenURI.
The supply local mirrors totalSupply as a temporary value inside reserveTokens.
The i local is only the loop counter of reserveTokens.
The balance local is only a temporary holder of the contract balance in withdraw.
The _tokenURI local is only a temporary mapping read inside tokenURI.
The base local is only a temporary holder of _baseURI() inside tokenURI.
